title: Bound local artifact retention and retire superseded datasets
changes: Keep current datasets and active inputs instead of retaining every historical generated dataset; review selected superseded datasets, Wine prefixes and rebuildable caches with identity checks, activity coordination and receipts.
validation: Reviewed three explicit plans and retired 89 superseded same-ROM EUR datasets from completed or successful managed and CLI scopes; retained the current e94-d93 dataset and the private debug archive.
limitations: Old revisions are no longer available at retired paths and require regeneration or an existing archive; other artifacts with uncertain dependencies and current work remain untouched.
